Dear [Mr Craik](/person/379)
There is [a new volume of Cameos](/book/134) just ready to come out, ending at Queen Elizabeth’s death. I suppose it must be called ‘Wars of the Reformation’ I do not like the term Wars of Religion.
I am also finishing off [Stray Pearls](/book/170), which will be completed in the [Monthly Packet](/periodical/52) in June, in 32 or 33 chapters - so I suppose it may come out about that time.

It is a sort of continuation of [the Chaplet of Pearls](/book/69) in the time of the Fronde, when the cavaliers were in exile.

Will you kindly desire a copy of [Magnum Bonum](/book/131) and of the [Clever Woman](/book/58) to be sent me
Yours very truly

C M Yonge
